integrity: An explicit finite certificate of 252 elementary simplicial collapses is completely reconstructed and checked from the graph adjacency, graph metric, 638 simplices, and 24-vertex sphere triangulation using a standalone standard-library program. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard 24-vertex rhombicuboctahedral edge graph with shortest-path metric at integer thresholds 1 and 2; not Euclidean Rips, other scales, or arbitrary Archimedean solids. Collapse witness is not asserted minimal. Unindexed prior equivalents remain a residual literature risk.
title: An explicit scale-two Rips collapse onto the rhombicuboctahedral sphere
